name: agentic-framework-mcp
displayName: Agentic Framework for Claude — MCP Servers
description: Optional MCP server bundle for the Agentic Framework: context7 (library docs; reads CONTEXT7_API_KEY env var at launch), filesystem (MCP_FS_ROOT, defaults to the project directory), serena (pinned to v1.6.1 by commit SHA), sequential-thinking, fetch, code-review-graph (persistent incremental code knowledge graph for reviews; pinned to 2.3.8). All launchers are version-pinned so npx/uvx resolve from cache instead of the network at each session start. Run /agentic-framework-mcp:setup after install to configure environment variables.
